title: Rabobank Replaces Visma on Women’s Jersey — No Confirmation Yet on Men’s Team
content:
Rabobank returns as title sponsor of the women's WorldTour team but questions remain around the men's team in the latest shakeup at the Visma-Lease a Bike franchise going into 2027.

Read the full article at Rabobank Replaces Visma on Women’s Jersey — No Confirmation Yet on Men’s Team on Velo.
author: ahood
